## About
Savoy Chiropractic is a small practice on E Mockingbird Ln in East Dallas, run by Dr. Benjamin Savoy with his wife and partner Melissa Savoy.
We treat a wide range of musculoskeletal conditions with a hands-on approach and gentle techniques. Every patient gets care fitted to their own needs, whether that is a specific treatment plan or an occasional visit to stay balanced, flexible and feeling well.
Patients have given us a 5 star rating across 28 Google reviews. Come find out why our patients love to refer their family, friends and co-workers.

## Services
- Back and neck pain: Hands-on relief care for back and neck pain. One reviewer said he knows exactly how to adjust her back and neck for the pain she is feeling.
- Arm, leg and joint pain: Relief care for pain in the arms, legs and joints.
- Disc problems: Relief care for disc problems.
- Stress management: Wellness care to help with stress.
- Sports and fitness care: Wellness care for active people and athletes.
- Family care of all ages: Chiropractic care for everyone in the family.
- Chronic pain management: Ongoing care to help manage chronic pain.

## FAQ
Q: Do you take insurance?
A: One reviewer mentioned that Dr. Savoy takes insurance. Please call the office to ask about your plan.

Q: Will I need x-rays?
A: Not always. We have in-house x-ray for your convenience, but we only recommend x-rays if they are absolutely necessary.

Q: Do I have to commit to a long treatment plan?
A: Care is based on your needs. Some conditions call for a specific treatment plan, and some people simply come in for occasional maintenance care.

Q: Do you have shorter hours on any day?
A: Yes. On Thursday we are open from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM. We are closed on Saturday and Sunday.
